yt-kissa.topic: Ep 15: At the Malhotra family puja, Riya wins over the aunts by baking Meera's favourite sweet from the diary's recipe, but Dadi breaks down tasting it and Vikram quietly swaps the diary's key page out of Riya's bag.
yt-kissa.why: Delivers the heart-winning payoff for Dadi's one-week deadline through the bakery, while Vikram's sabotage keeps the central mystery under threat.

yt-kissa.topic: Ep 16: Kabir finds the missing diary page in Vikram's study, showing Meera signed over shares of the company to little Kabir the night she vanished, but a hidden camera catches him, and Vikram now knows exactly what Kabir has learned.
yt-kissa.why: Reveals the financial motive behind Meera's disappearance and why Vikram wants Kabir married and controlled, and escalates the cat-and-mouse with the uncle.

yt-kissa.topic: Ep 17: Vikram, cornered, offers Riya a deal: leave Kabir within 24 hours and he will cancel Ramesh Saxena's remaining debt papers and give the bakery back, and Riya, torn, realises she cannot say no without telling Kabir the truth about the contract's real cost.
yt-kissa.why: Ends the arc on a cliffhanger moral dilemma that tests whether she picks the bakery or Kabir, setting up the midpoint turn as feelings and the contract collide.

yt-kissa.topic: Ep 18: Riya keeps Vikram's offer secret and tries to push Kabir away with a cold fight, but Kabir finds Vikram's 24-hour deadline message on her phone and, instead of anger, tears up the contract in front of her, only for Aarav to reveal that the torn pages are just a copy and the original is in Vikram's spy's hands.
yt-kissa.why: It builds on Ep 17's ultimatum by forcing the secret into the open and escalating the 'no feelings' rule-breaking, with Kabir choosing Riya over the contract. The twist, that the original contract is still with Vikram's spy, keeps the threat of exposure alive and raises the stakes toward the day-100 reveal, while giving Aarav a bigger role as the second lead.

yt-kissa.topic: Ep 19: Riya and Kabir race to find the spy holding the original contract, and the trail leads to Sharda's chawl, where the diary's last line finally shows the name Meera feared. Before Riya can read it aloud, Dadi walks in with the spy and the contract in her hands.
yt-kissa.why: Ep 18 ended on the original contract being in the spy's hands, so Ep 19 pays that off by tying the hunt to the Sharda and diary thread. It also brings the main secret and the contract exposure to one tense cliffhanger at the halfway mark. Dadi arriving at the chawl raises the stakes for Meera's story and for the fake marriage.

yt-kissa.topic: Ep 20: Dadi stands in Sharda's chawl holding the original contract and the spy, and demands the truth. Riya and Kabir confess the fake marriage, but Sharda, rising from her bed, reads the diary's last line aloud and names the person Meera feared as Dadi's trusted ally, not Vikram. The name shocks Dadi into silence, and it hints that Vikram has been a pawn all along.
yt-kissa.why: Episode 19 ends on the confrontation, so this episode must pay off the reveal of the name and the contract exposure. It keeps the mid-season turn credible: the contract is exposed early to Dadi, so the rule 'no one finds out' breaks while a bigger secret opens up and the second half stays driven by the mystery. It also gives Sharda and Dadi a stronger role and sets up the Aarav and Kavita threads.

yt-instinct.topic: Le corbeau qui fabrique des outils : l'intelligence d'un enfant de 7 ans #Shorts
yt-instinct.why: 19:30 IST = 16:00 à Paris, 10:00 à Montréal : début d'après-midi pour les familles, créneau matinée au Québec. Études sur le corbeau calédonien (Oxford) solides, vidéo stock facile.

yt-instinct.topic: La grenouille de bois qui gèle complètement puis ressuscite #Shorts
yt-instinct.why: Soirée en Europe (21:00 Paris) et après-midi au Québec. Adaptation extrême, bien documentée (Rana sylvatica, glucose antigel), hook de 'mort puis retour à la vie'.

yt-instinct.topic: Le poulpe mimétique qui imite d'autres animaux pour survivre #Shorts
yt-instinct.why: Créneau 16:00 Paris / 10:00 Montréal. Sujet visuel, curiosité forte, comportement décrit en 1998 en Indonésie. Contenu différent du Short déjà fait sur les 3 cœurs du poulpe : angle camouflage et imitation.

yt-instinct.topic: Pourquoi les éléphants se souviennent des morts et reviennent sur leurs os #Shorts
yt-instinct.why: Soirée en Europe, public adulte réceptif à l'émotion. Comportement documenté par des chercheurs (Douglas-Hamilton, McComb), narration simple avec images stock.

yt-instinct.topic: Le poisson-archer qui crache de l'eau pour chasser avec précision #Shorts
yt-instinct.why: Après-midi européen et matinée québécoise, idéal pour les familles. Fait solide (correction de la réfraction, étude de Schuster), hook visuel immédiat et facile à illustrer avec des images IA.

yt-instinct.topic: Le tardigrade : l'animal microscopique qui survit au vide spatial, à la déshydratation et aux radiations en se mettant en pause (état de cryptobiose) #Shorts
yt-instinct.why: Slot Fri 30 Oct 06:50 IST (soit 03:20 en France, publié pour le public francophone du matin et de Québec la veille au soir). Sujet intemporel, solide scientifiquement (expérience FOTON-M3 de 2007 en orbite), au hook fort : « un animal qui survit dans l'espace ». Il ne répète ni le poulpe, ni le dauphin, ni les sujets déjà planifiés (corbeau, grenouille de bois, poulpe mimétique, éléphants, poisson-archer), et il apporte de la variété avec un invertébré microscopique, idéal pour des images de synthèse IA en complément d'images d'archives.

yt-hopeverse.topic: Israel votes Tue 27 Oct 2026, its first election since the 7 Oct 2023 Hamas attacks. Explain why it is a referendum on Netanyahu. Polls show Gadi Eisenkot's bloc ahead by about 4.5 seats, but neither bloc reaches the 61-seat majority. Netanyahu's outgoing coalition averages about 50 seats, which is 11 short. Cover what is at stake, how the coalition math works, and what happens if the Knesset deadlocks. Under 60 seconds, for an international audience.
yt-hopeverse.why: The vote takes place on the day of this slot, and every major outlet (CNBC, NPR, CBS, JPost) was leading with it on 25-26 Oct. It is a big, clear story with numbers, and international viewers will be searching for it as results come in.

yt-hopeverse.topic: Jamia Millia Islamia agrees to hold student union polls after 21 years, ending a hunger strike. It revokes suspensions and orders a probe into security personnel conduct
yt-hopeverse.why: A campus story with a clear sequence of events and a '21 years' number. It suits the student-heavy Indian audience at 09:00 IST.

yt-hopeverse.topic: Bihar BJP worker files a police complaint at Patna's Kotwali station over Kharge's 'baap' remark aimed at Modi, filed Sunday evening: what he said and what the complaint means
yt-hopeverse.why: A fast-moving political story from the last 24 hours with a clear who and what. It suits the 13:00 IST slot, when Indian viewers are looking for the day's political updates.

yt-hopeverse.topic: Venezuela's opposition leader and Nobel Peace laureate María Corina Machado returned home on Sunday 25 Oct 2026 after more than 10 months in exile. Tens of thousands cheered her on the road to Caracas. Explain why she left, how the US toppled Maduro a month after she went, and why her return could challenge the interim government and push for an election date. Under 60 seconds.
yt-hopeverse.why: Reuters, CNN, NPR and BBC all reported it on 25-26 Oct. It is a fresh, visual story with a clear arc, and it has not been covered or planned yet. The Indian audience follows US-linked world events and Nobel stories. I could not find a verified India-specific story for this slot because my search limit ran out, so this is the strongest dated world story I confirmed. Swap in a fresh India headline from the morning of 28 Oct if the owner prefers.

yt-hopeverse.topic: Cyclone Arnab, which the IMD expects to hit the Andhra Pradesh coast on Wed 28 Oct 2026. The IMD said on 26 Oct that it should cross between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam (Yanam included) as a very severe cyclonic storm. Winds should be 115-125 kmph, gusting to 140 kmph, by the forenoon of 28 Oct. The Cabinet Secretary has reviewed preparedness, and the Andhra CM has told officials to aim for zero casualties. Cover where and when it lands, which areas are at risk (heavy rain, storm surge), and what people on the coast should do. Keep it under 60 seconds and open with the landfall hour, since the Short goes up at 08:05 IST on landfall morning.
yt-hopeverse.why: The cyclone hits on the morning of the upload, so it is the most time-sensitive story for Indian viewers at that hour. It is also a safety story with a hard wind-speed number. None of the Shorts already made or planned cover it. They cover Jio IPO, Gaganyaan, the Jamia polls, Rahul Gandhi and Kharge.

yt-hopeverse.topic: Cyclone Arnab landfall update, Wed 28 Oct 2026. Cover where the very severe cyclonic storm crossed the Andhra Pradesh coast between Bapatla and Visakhapatnam, the wind speeds recorded against the IMD forecast of 115-125 kmph gusting to 140, and what damage or evacuations were reported. Close with what coastal residents should do in the next 24 hours. Before publishing, check the IMD bulletin for the actual landfall time and figures. Don't use the forecast numbers as if they were observed.
yt-hopeverse.why: Landfall is the biggest India story on this date, and a 10:10 post-landfall Short is a different angle from the 08:05 forecast Short. My web search quota ran out, so I could not confirm any newer story from the last 48 hours. This pick builds on a story already in the plan. Check it against live news before production.

yt-sawaal.topic: Fri 30 Oct 07:40 IST: Rahul Gandhi's vow to keep protesting until Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar resigns. Rahul, Priyanka Gandhi Vadra and other INDIA bloc MPs were detained for two hours on the night of 7 Oct 2026. Two outlets reported it: The Week (7 Oct) and Nikkei Asia (7 Oct, on the protests over the nationwide voter-roll revision). Angle: 'Why are MPs detained for demanding a CEC's resignation, and what is the Election Commission's answer?' The Short is in English and Hindi, with the opinion segment clearly marked. Use Wikimedia Commons photos of Rahul Gandhi and the Congress flag, and have the AI anchors read the facts. Before scripting, check for any newer development from 27–29 Oct. Also avoid repeating the 3 crore voters SC-notice Short. Cover only the protest, the detention and the resignation demand, and attribute the Nikkei analyst's 'credibility' claim to Nikkei.
yt-sawaal.why: The CEC-resignation demand is the opposition's central confrontation with the government and the Election Commission, and the voter-roll revision is a live issue before early-2027 state polls. A morning Short with a hard number (two hours of detention) and two independent sources fits the channel's double-sourcing rule. It is a different story from the voter-deletion petition and the BRICS cost Shorts already made. Caveat: my search was cut off before I could confirm anything newer than 7 Oct, so swap in a fresher double-sourced clash if one emerges.
